collection.description: Two villagers compete to build the tallest balanced pebble stack.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: Two villagers compete to build the tallest balanced pebble stack. The game ends only when the tide reaches their feet.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: Two villagers compete to build the tallest balanced pebble stack. One particularly pretty stone is carried home as a keepsake.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: Two villagers compete to build the tallest balanced pebble stack. The first attempt fails spectacularly, provoking laughter.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: Two villagers compete to build the tallest balanced pebble stack. (Name1) becomes far more competitive than intended.
